create_lbfgs_optimizer: create an LBFGS optimizer instance with configurable learning rate and history size
run_lbfgs_step: run a single LBFGS optimization step with a closure that returns the loss
build_cubic_interpolate: build cubic interpolation between two points with function and derivative values for line search
run_strong_wolfe_line_search: run strong Wolfe condition line search to find an acceptable step size
test_lbfgs_convergence: test LBFGS convergence on a function using tolerance_grad and tolerance_change thresholds
